description:
Functional Business Card Magnets, Built to Stay in Sight

Business card magnets help your brand stay visible long after the first meeting. Unlike traditional cards, these double as fridge magnets that your customers will see every day. Ideal for home services, real estate, food delivery, and local promotions, they combine contact information with everyday function. It’s a simple way to stay top of mind without being tucked away in a wallet or drawer.

Marketing That Works Every Day

Consistent Visibility 
Durable and Waterproof
Flexible Sizes 
Seen multiple times in a day on  refrigerator doors or filing cabinets Printed on 17 pt. magnet-backed cardstock Standard size: 2" x 3.5" 
Great for repeat services and local promotions  Finished with a protective UV coating Custom sizes also available 
Helps build brand familiarity over time  Resistant to moisture and everyday handling Fits easily into mailers and leave-behinds

Custom Business Card Magnets Made Easy








Create magnetic business cards that reflect your brand.  

  • Upload your own artwork or use our online design tool to build your layout.  
  • Choose from full-color printing and add logos, photos, contact details, or service info.  
  • You can also design magnets with calendars or promotional offers for added value.  

 

Each magnet is printed on one side and cut to the size that suits your needs. 




Business Card Magnets FAQs

Q: Will these magnets stick on all surfaces?

They stick on any magnetic surface such as refrigerators, filing cabinets, or metal doors. They will not stick to glass, plastic, or wood. 

Q: Are the magnets waterproof?

Yes. The UV coating helps protect the surface from moisture and keeps your design looking sharp even in humid environments.

Q: Can I create my magnet design online?

Yes. You can design directly on our website using the online tool or upload a print-ready file created elsewhere.
